report.markdown:
# Allele-based Pathogen Identification Workflow Report
Below are the results for the Allele based Pathogenic Identification Workflow

This workflow was run on:

```galaxy
generate_time()
```

With Galaxy version:

```galaxy
generate_galaxy_version()
```

## Workflow Inputs
The Perprocessing workflow main output (Collection of all samples reads after quality retaining and hosts filtering), and a FASTA file of the reference genome of the main Pathogen identified in the Gene based Pathogen Identification workflow, or per-known to the user.

## Workflow Output: 

### All variants found per sample against the reference genome

```galaxy
history_dataset_display(output="extracted_fields_from_the_vcf_output")
```

### Number of variants per sample

```galaxy
history_dataset_display(output="number_of_variants_per_sample")
```

### Mapping mean depth of coverage per sample

```galaxy
history_dataset_display(output="mapping_mean_depth_per_sample")
```

### Mapping breadth of coverage percentage per sample

```galaxy
history_dataset_display(output="mapping_coverage_percentage_per_sample")
```
